eventDetail.scope: The ICCST is focused on the research, development, testing, and systems engineering of electronic security technology, including the operational testing, life-cycle, and performance. ICCST is an annual IEEE conference which provides a forum to share and discuss advances in security technology. Its scope is quite broad and includes both theoretical and applied work.
